integrity: All asymptotic steps are derived from explicitly cited formulas; finite numerical checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns the width between a rigorous lower bound and entanglement of formation, not the unknown true regularization gap.
No exact finite-dimensional maximizer of the interval width is claimed.
The asymptotic lower witness uses the affine entanglement-of-formation branch only for sufficiently large dimension.
title: Sharp \(d^{-2/3}\) asymptotic for the qudit isotropic entanglement-cost certificate gap
